title: Net 30 across the March clock change is due on the 30th day
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds Net 30.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-11 Customer.
  • The work order belongs to {Location-A}, whose time zone has daylight saving time.
    For example: {Location-A} is in Edmonton (Mountain time).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is complete and ready to invoice (every part received, review done).
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-15440.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}'s Finance tab.
  2. Set Invoice Date to Mar 1, 2027.
  3. Set Invoice Date to Feb 20, 2027.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the invoice preview shows Invoice Date and Due date.
  • Step 2: the Due date reads Mar 31, 2027 (Mar 1 + 30; the clocks change on Mar 14, 2027 and the date does not move).
  • Step 3: the Due date reads Mar 22, 2027 (Feb 20 + 30: 8 days to Feb 28, then 22).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R10: “A Net 30 invoice or vendor invoice whose span crosses the March or November clock change is due on the 30th calendar day after its date.”
  • S7-R6: “Due dates are counted on the calendar of the location the invoice or vendor invoice belongs to, never the location of the user, API connection or import that creates or views it, so a daylight saving change inside the span never moves the date: an Edmonton invoice dated Oct 5 on "10th of the following month" is due Nov 10 (not Nov 9).”
